description: This PHP source file implements a web page for configuring Wi-Fi network settings in a router or gateway device. It includes form handling, client-side validation, and dynamic UI adjustments for Wi-Fi SSID, security mode, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, with support for mesh mode and user session management.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to the server via AJAX for saving.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and calls set_config to save Wi-Fi settings.
